evals.prompt: Run the no-comments skill on evals/files/billing (a Go module, copy it somewhere scratch first). Scope: every comment in fee.go. Apply the accepted findings; run `go test ./...` at the end.
evals.expected_output: Junk comments gone, protected ones kept, the business-rule reason moved into a named function plus a test, over-long doc comments cut; tests still pass.
expectations: The license header at the top of fee.go is still present
The `fee calculation` banner, the `check whether the total is negative` comment and the `multiply the total by 29` comment are removed
The commented-out `resp, err := c.Do(req)` / `log.Println(resp)` lines are removed
The `Orders over $10k skip fraud review: finance policy` comment is removed, and the rule now lives in a named function or constant in fee.go plus a test in fee_test.go whose name states the policy
The public Fee doc comment is still present but is 5 lines or fewer
The doc comment on the internal retries function is 3 lines or fewer, or the comment is gone
The keep-alive comment with the issues/412 link is still present
The `Gateway requires the exact header casing` comment is still present
`go test ./...` passes in the final state
The final report gives a kill count and lists the kept comments

evals.prompt: Use the no-comments skill on evals/files/billing (copy it to scratch first), but scope it to the Charge function in fee.go only. I'm cleaning up in phases, so don't touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: Only Charge's junk is removed; every comment outside Charge is byte-identical; out-of-scope comments are not reported as killed.
expectations: The commented-out code inside Charge is removed
Both protected comments inside Charge (keep-alive with the issue link, header casing) are still present
Every comment outside Charge, including the banner, the narration comments in Fee and the long retries comment, is unchanged
The report does not count out-of-scope comments as deleted
